Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you
reported in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, but I still need your name for the file.
A: Understood. It's the person you have listed on the claim.
Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I was driving in the right lane on the main road, heading toward the shopping center. I signaled to move into the left
lane because I needed to get over for a turn coming up.
Q: Did you check your mirrors and blind spot before changing lanes?
A: I checked the mirror and I glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I started to move
over.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other vehicle was in the left lane, a bit back, and then it was suddenly right next to me. Our side mirrors
touched and I felt my car shove sideways. I braked and pulled onto the shoulder.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: Not right away. About an hour later my right shoulder started hurting badly, and by the next morning I could barely
lift my arm above my chest.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an uregnt care clinic the following day and they recommended an imagnig appointment. I've been
doing physical therapy twice a week snice then.
Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?
A: I don't believe so. The other dirver stopped briefly and then left the area before the police arrived.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Only that my car has damage along the passenger side and I'd like the repair handled quickly.
Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with the repair shop and your medical providers. This concludes the statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
